text:
Ravi: FYI AcmeNova POC blocked by procurement. They need signed MSA+DPA + PO before we spin up Dedicated nodes. They want net45, HSM/KMS, and 5yr log retention.
Leah (Legal): Please attach their redline. Immediate concerns: assignment of IP and broad audit rights. We usually limit audits to third-party assessors with notice.
Ravi: Linking redline now. They also insist on liquidated damages for downtime.
Ibrahim (Security): LDs tied to uptime are risky. Propose cap = fees paid in past 12 months or $50k. On-site audits: allow accredited auditors with 30 days' notice and scoping. 5yr logs is storage-heavy; offer 12 months standard, 36 months paid.
Maya (Finance): Net45 for sub-$25k deals ok with an exception. Need PO before provision. I'll open a billing exception ticket.
Ravi: POC numbers: $18k one-time + $5k KMS setup. Draft order form snippet: ```
Product: Redwood Dedicated - POC
Config: 1x A100-class (30 days)
Fees: $18,000 one-time
KMS onboarding: $5,000 one-time
Payment: Net45 (PO required)
```
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0xdef456 sent to procurement@acmenova.com, status: sent.
Leah (Legal): Good. I'll swap IP assignment for a limited operational license and add KMS appendix. Also reject unlimited audit rights; propose scoped audit clause.
Ibrahim (Security): KMS onboarding checklist for ENG: ```
- Customer provides cross-account role with least privilege
- Onboarding window: 48-72h
- Fallback: Redwood-managed key for initial provisioning
- No direct key export allowed
```
Maya (Finance): Ticket FIN-4720 created, owner: Maya. Pending PO and legal sign-off before provisioning.
Ravi: Action items: 1) I'll send trimmed redline to customer, 2) @Leah review and sign, 3) @Maya hold until PO. Thanks all :thumbsup:
